name: Torznab indexers
description: Lets Find online search through your own torrent indexer. You run Jackett or Prowlarr yourself, add its address and API key below, and Drift sends your searches to it. It does nothing until you add an indexer.

settings.label: Indexers
settings.help: Torznab is the search API that Jackett and Prowlarr offer. Run one of them yourself and point Drift at it, so what gets searched is your choice. Keys are stored only on this computer and are never shown again.
